summary: The ui-source revision the set admin is built and tested against: the overlay is ui-source at this revision with this folder's src/, tests/ and docs/ laid over it, and ui-builder's package build builds the same (standards simai.component-set 1.0.0 and simai.component-package 1.1.1). It is the source of the released SIMAI Framework pair ui-73df5d1b4d4c (ui-source main 5e30b946fd0e, group build 19, core.runtime 1.69.0, core.styles 1.25.0), which registers the set's names and carries simai.admin-navigation-port 1.2.0. The same commit is framework.source_revision in set.json.
